name: Ahaziah
summary: A son of Ahab who ruled Israel from Samaria for two years and served Baal as his father had. After a fall he sent to ask a foreign god whether he would recover, and he died as Elijah said.

key_moments.title: In His Father's Ways
key_moments.description: Ahaziah became king of Israel, ruling from Samaria. He did evil, following his father and mother, and he served and worshipped Baal.

key_moments.title: A Question for Baal-zebub
key_moments.description: Ahaziah fell through a window lattice upstairs and sent messengers to ask Baal-zebub, the god of Ekron, if he would get well. Elijah met them with the LORD's word that he would never leave his bed, and he died.

key_moments.title: Ships That Never Sailed
key_moments.description: Jehoshaphat king of Judah teamed up with Ahaziah to build ships bound for Tarshish. A prophet said the LORD would break them for this, and the ships were wrecked.
